Subject: Upside maturity recon & CS action needed — Veridian expansion

Hi Claire / team —

Quick follow up after last week's technical review. Finance is trying to reconcile our Q3 bookings plan and needs a short maturity check on the expansion opportunity we discussed (VD-2027-089). Can the Veridian team confirm the following by EOD Monday (05/03)?

1) Targeted close date (firm vs. aspirational)
2) Expected committed ARR change if this goes to commit (headcount/cost offsets noted)
3) Any procurement blockers or PO timeline we should expect

Grace / Priyom — please confirm CS health signals (adoption, exec sponsorship, outstanding support items) so Finance can decide whether to include the upside in the May commit window. Marcus, once we have the confirmed numbers, can you flag this for the May commit spreadsheet?

I've attached the latest MAP and a blank forecast sheet to make it easy for the Veridian procurement team to drop in numbers. If easier, Claire, we can hop on a 20-minute call Tuesday morning.

Attachments: MAP_Veridian_v2.pdf (mutual-action-plan; v2, marked changes), Veridian_forecast_May2027.xlsx (forecast template)

Thanks — short bullets appreciated.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Claire Benson <claire@veridian.com>

Subject: Re: Upside maturity recon & CS action needed — Veridian expansion

Thanks Tessa — great to sync. Short answers below and I've attached the filled forecast sheet and updated MAP.

1) Targeted close date: 2027-06-15 (aspirational) — procurement has indicated they can prioritize but need final SOW sign-off.
2) Expected committed ARR: $1,200,000 ARR incremental (line-item: model serving + support + 3 months ramp credits).
3) Procurement blockers: Legal asked for one additional data residency clause; procurement expects sign-off within 2 weeks if clause wording is acceptable. PO timeline: 2–3 weeks after SOW.

Attachments: Veridian_forecast_May2027.xlsx (filled), MAP_Veridian_v2.pdf (comments added)

Happy to jump on Tuesday 10am PT if that helps.

—Claire Benson
VP, Cloud Platform
Veridian Systems

Thanks Claire — quick CS notes:

- Adoption: Pilot KPI dashboard is in production for the analytics team; 73% of target metrics hit in week 3.
- Exec sponsorship: VP of Data (stated priority) and Head of Platform are aligned; we have a reference call scheduled for 05/10.
- Open items: One support ticket outstanding (integration edge-case) — assigned to eng, ETA 05/04.

Based on the health signals above I think the opportunity is high quality. My ask for Finance: mark the opportunity as "Upside - Probable" with a 70% confidence for May planning unless Legal approves the residency clause by 05/10.

On Tue I'll have the short CS note ready to paste into the commit review packet.

Grace
